name: West Papua (Morning Star flag)
description: A red vertical band at the hoist bearing a white five-pointed star, beside thirteen horizontal stripes alternating blue and white.
history: The Morning Star (Bintang Kejora) was first raised on 1 December 1961 as the flag of the emerging West Papuan state under Dutch New Guinea's decolonization program, flown beside the Dutch tricolor. After Indonesia took the territory in 1963 the flag became — and remains — the banned emblem of Papuan identity and the independence movement; raising it in Indonesia carries a prison sentence.

features.symbolism: the morning star Venus — the coming dawn of the Papuan nation
